brief:
Prepare an entry for an AI-judged public benchmark board the way a harness lane does it: label every figure by how it was obtained, gate the package, run critic rounds (including a seat that plays the judge) before filing, make every step between measured figures measured or proved, never declare a bound below its true value, mint and verify the evidence bundle BEFORE submit so the note carries the κ root, name the harness once, hold an entry that will not reach the frontier, and keep every negative as a leaf. Use when someone says "prepare the submission", "ready to file?", "write the note", "pre-submit checklist", "the judge returned it not evaluable / refuted", "should we file or hold", "critic this package", or is about to run a board CLI's submit. Board-neutral: it encodes the order of work and the refusals, not any board's scores.

`measure · gate · critic · mint · file`

A public board with an AI judge reads the claim, the proof and the organizer's own check reports, not your intent. Everything filed is public at once and cannot be edited.
